links.outcome: LLM vs MFM specialist accuracy ratings on same hypothetical cases, blinded evaluation
links.effect: No significant difference between ChatGPT-4 and clinicians in median accuracy (Wilcoxon p = 0.18); Gemini significantly lower accuracy (p < 0.01).
links.quote: No significant difference was found between ChatGPT-4 and clinicians in median accuracy scores (Wilcoxon p = 0.18), while Gemini showed significantly lower accuracy (p < 0.01).

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT-4 and Gemini against human specialist responses on 20 hypothetical maternal-fetal medicine clinical vignettes evaluated by blinded specialists, assessing LLM accuracy and alignment without testing an organizational deployment safeguard.
